description.value: The Locavore Bar & Grill grew from a humble food truck into a vibrant hybrid indoor/outdoor venue set inside former greenhouses on the edge of Squamish, sharing a property with the Cloudburst Cafe. The kitchen focuses on local BC flavours for lunch and dinner, with a bar program built around regional cocktails, beer, and wine. The venue explicitly positions itself as a destination for unwinding after mountain biking or hiking, making it a natural stop on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is an active restaurant/cafe hybrid at 1861 Mamquam Road, Squamish. The site explicitly mentions mountain biking and hiking as context for visiting, supporting cycling relevance. The website lists a phone number (604 390 1078) absent from OSM, and shows a postal code (V8B 0H5) that differs from OSM (V8B 0G2); per rules, the website value is preferred and the discrepancy is flagged.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V8B 0G2, website footer consistently shows V8B 0H5 — website value used.
Phone number (604 390 1078) is absent from OSM; sourced from website only.
Bike parking is not mentioned anywhere in website content or OSM tags — a key WWC criterion remains unverified.
The Cloudburst Cafe appears to be a co-located but separately branded business on the same property; the OSM record covers only The Locavore Bar & Grill.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant in Squamish that explicitly markets itself to mountain bikers and hikers; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route. Bike parking confirmation would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The property operates two concepts: Locavore Bar & Grill (lunch/dinner) and Cloudburst Cafe (breakfast/coffee). Both share the same address and phone. The OSM record is specifically for the Locavore side, but cyclists arriving at this address have access to both.
